source.text: Participants must have histologically and/or molecularly confirmed CNS embryonal tumor (see eligible tumor types below), OR ependymoma that is recurrent/progressive following standard of care treatment.
Participants must have evaluable disease in the central nervous system to be eligible. Evaluable disease includes either measurable OR non-measurable disease
Participants with any prior immunodeficiency or history of autoimmune disease requiring systemic steroids/ immunosuppressive medication/ disease-modifying agents within the last two (2) years.
Ongoing infection with HIV or hepatitis B (HBsAg positive) or hepatitis C virus (anti-HCV positive).
